statement: Cerebras claims the CS-4 delivers up to 30x more tokens-per-second-per-user versus GPU solutions on GPT-OSS-120B and up to 10x higher throughput per watt than CS-3.
why: If inference throughput per watt improves this much on non-GPU silicon, power-constrained operators gain a way to serve tokens without adding GPU capacity.

impact.mechanism: Higher claimed tokens per second and throughput per watt on alternative silicon lets power-limited sites serve more inference per watt, substituting for incremental merchant-GPU deployment.

evidence.excerpt: up to 30x more tokens-per-second-per-user versus GPU solutions on GPT-OSS-120B; up to 10x higher throughput per watt compared to CS-3

confidence.basis: Marketing performance claims from the vendor's own release and blog with no independent benchmark; capped at medium.

dispersion: Claims are stated as upper bounds ('up to') on a specific model and workload, not a general average.
